issues.description: Closure example in 'Using preview functions with data context' contradicts the stated limitation.
issues.detail: The section says preview functions don't have access to inputs/outputs, then demonstrates a closure over a hardcoded sample_data list defined at pipeline-construction time. That isn't 'data context' — it's a literal. Either show actually loading from the catalog inside the preview_fn, or drop the section. As written, the data structure (preview_fn as a zero-arg callable) is doing exactly what it should; the prose is muddying it.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code after return.
issues.detail: The commented alternative sits below an unconditional return, so a reader copy-pasting gets only the URL form and the data-URI hint is dead. Split into two separate functions or put the alternative in a comment block above the return. Small thing, but docs are read by people who paste literally.

issues.description: Seven preview subclasses where a tagged struct would do.
issues.detail: JsonPreview, TablePreview, PlotlyPreview, MermaidPreview, ImagePreview, TextPreview, CustomPreview differ only by a type tag and a content shape. That's a discriminated union, not a hierarchy. The docs aren't the place to fix it, but worth flagging upstream: CustomPreview already proves one struct with a renderer_key carries the load. Data dominates; the algorithm (dispatch on tag) is then self-evident.

issues.description: 'next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)' is cleverness without a job.
issues.detail: It's just pipeline.nodes[0], or better, name the node and look it up. The generator expression suggests filtering that isn't happening. Prefer the obvious form in teaching code; readers learn the idiom you show them.

issues.description: Custom Mermaid config example bundles two unrelated concerns under one meta dict.
issues.detail: The meta dict mixes Mermaid library config (securityLevel, flowchart, themeVariables) with a Kedro-Viz-specific textStyle CSS bag. These are different data, consumed by different renderers. The doc should at least name the split; right now the shape suggests they're all Mermaid options and a reader will be surprised when textStyle doesn't appear in Mermaid's own schema link.

issues.description: RELEASE.md and tests checkboxes unchecked for user-facing feature docs.
issues.detail: Self-reported in the PR checklist. Docs-only PRs still benefit from a one-line RELEASE entry pointing users at the new section, and the closure / multiple-preview-type examples would benefit from at least a doctest-style smoke check so they don't rot. Not a code bug, but worth not waving past.

review.summary: Docs-only PR adding a substantial new section to nodes.md covering the experimental preview_fn feature. The writing is clear and the examples are mostly copy-pasteable, which is the right bar for docs. Two examples have small but real problems: the 'data context' closure example contradicts its own framing by closing over a literal rather than data, and the ImagePreview example has unreachable code after a return. A few smaller nits around teaching-code idioms and the mixed-concern meta dict. The underlying API surface (seven Preview subclasses) looks like a discriminated union wearing a class hierarchy, but that's an upstream design observation, not a blocker for these docs.
